basis: Source and existing documentation review; no production session, deployment verification or new application tests performed by this feature inventory.

status_definitions.implemented in repository: Capability is implemented in the reviewed repository; actual event configuration and serving release may differ.
status_definitions.implemented but gated or needs setup: Implementation exists, but operation needs configuration, a switch, external provider or recorded human prerequisites. No live state was inspected.
status_definitions.accepted design not implemented: The presentation direction was accepted; implementation remains open.
status_definitions.later planned: Tracked future scope or a proposed extension; approval, timing and completion vary by owner issue.
status_definitions.unknown: Evidence insufficient; do not infer either implementation or absence.

features.feature: Public front door, calendar and club finder
features.capability: The homepage connects My account, My club, conference calendar and Find a club; calendar has informational entries, ICS feeds/import, recurrence and links to registration.
features.boundary: The full searchable/filterable event directory and embeddable calendar remain broader scope. Crowded-day/finder feedback changes are proposed, not shipped.

features.capability: Event landing pages compose published content, registration choices, resources and lifecycle-aware actions; editors manage assets and sections.
features.boundary: The proposed composed Public page & links workspace and preview refinements are not the current UI. Saved-link correction remains open.

features.feature: Individual, family, club and group registration
features.capability: Versioned forms support registration/person scope, repeating attendees, directories, validation, pricing, review, capacity and waitlists; club directors select roster members.
features.boundary: One multi-person booking does not establish permanent household identity, guardian authority or staff access.

features.capability: Save explicit drafts, preview/test, publish versions and replace an unpublished draft from a template; submissions keep their own published version. A test submission is required before the first publication only.
features.boundary: The three-zone editor, complete phone editor, All/Any groups and saved question library remain future work.

features.feature: Event starters, form starters and annual copy
features.capability: Data-backed event templates/starters and seeded form templates are applied as copies; annual event cloning can copy selected configuration without operational history.
features.boundary: Event template administration is currently technical/raw JSON. App-editable Form templates and source-change notices are not yet implemented; saving an event as a template remains separate scope.

features.capability: Private management access and verified attendee accounts provide eligible registration details, permitted edits, balances, assignments, published messages and owned QR passes.
features.boundary: Editing depends on the field and policy. Cancelled/waitlisted account summaries have a focused lifecycle correction open; the accepted new attendee layout is not built.

features.feature: Linked account and one sign-in foundation
features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: User and AttendeeAccount are linked 1:1 behind a sign-in switch; combined entry, hand-link tooling, passkey entry and both-side sign-out foundations exist.
features.boundary: The two tables/session boundaries remain. The switch defaults off; production enablement/linking and actual serving state are not established by this report.

features.capability: Server-side event memberships, named permissions, global administration, staff invitations and authorized workspace routing are implemented.
features.boundary: Only genuine grants/sessions permit entry. Kitchen-only staff do not gain ordinary event/registration access; protected records use narrower domain guards.

features.capability: Event features shows module and feature state, permitted switches and links to owning settings; event creation can select supported feature configuration.
features.boundary: A feature row or module switch is not evidence that every capability in that domain is finished. Settings require the current server permission.

features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: Square integration, manual cash/check/card records, payment attempts, refunds, adjustment history, promo codes, scholarship matching and cancellation requests are present.
features.boundary: Processor configuration and real-provider rehearsal are operational evidence. Refund execution, real pricing/capacity changes and production activity retain human controls; generalized ledger/credits remain later work.

features.capability: Responsible organizations, reviewed billable units, immutable drafts/finalization/revisions, invoice PDFs, receivables, payments and statements exist.
features.boundary: A director who submits a church-billed registration is not the personal debtor. Invoice finalization has its own permission; it is not inherited by every finance role.

features.capability: Signed attendee passes, scanner/desk check-in, undo, whole-club workflows, printable rosters and Avery badge sheets are implemented.
features.boundary: A dedicated staff-run event station is still planned. Single-name label printing waits on printer/device decisions; the current station proposal excludes printing.

features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: The imported CSV/date list is matched at lookup. Registration/login/roster access stay available; applicable youth/children’s adult/staff check-in follows the delivered gate and audited override.
features.boundary: Serving-release sign-off, mapping, human import review and fallback evidence remain distinct. Instructor roster access uses the specifically recorded warning behavior.

features.capability: Club grants, encrypted birth dates, roster edits/import/carry-forward, club forms, Monthly Records, points, honors/classes, orders and export formats exist.
features.boundary: Director/deputy, registrar and reporter capabilities differ. Current new-club applications are Pathfinder-only; future Adventurer parity is a separate project.

features.capability: The existing coordinator workspace supports available-club oversight, Monthly Records/points, view-only club data and narrow permitted reviews.
features.boundary: Current source queries all active clubs. Future ministry-scoped grants are decided in direction but not implemented by the accepted layout; ordinary club/report oversight is read-only.

features.capability: Catalogs, scheduled class offerings, live seats, prerequisites, class waitlists, staff schedule board, instructor rosters, attendance/completion write-back and class-change email options exist.
features.boundary: Teachers see only assigned roster fields, subject to their second-step and edit window; completion correction/voiding keeps existing authority.

features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: Camp Heritage/Sunnydale templates, event layout snapshots, night availability, holds/rates, requests, assignments, moves and lodging waitlists exist.
features.boundary: A request is not an assignment. Exact property layout, inventory, prices and event configuration need operational verification. This is not proof of a complete residential youth-camp model.

features.feature: Meal services, plans, tickets and kitchen counts
features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: Meal plans/selections/pricing, ticket CSV, conference-paid entitlements, café result imports, served-versus-sold reporting and append-only kitchen counts exist.
features.boundary: Meal money closeout is the remaining #212 slice. A sold ticket, café redemption, prepared count and collected money are different facts; protected allergy expansion remains separate.

features.capability: Keys/badges/wristbands/assets can be issued, returned, corrected and reconciled; deposits/charges and facility blocks retain history.
features.boundary: It is an event-issued asset workflow, not an inventory purchasing system or complete camp-store/POS wallet.

features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: Central Email settings, event pause/sender controls, versioned templates, reviewed broadcasts, scheduling, audience selection, attachments/images, delivery attempts/retries, preferences and form-routed notifications exist.
features.boundary: Provider transport/configuration determines real delivery evidence. SES bounce/complaint handling remains open; expanded ready-made announcement sections and the persisted admin feed are not implemented.

features.capability: Operational reports and scoped CSVs support current domains; registration PDFs preserve submission versions and update copies with documented redaction/approved exceptions.
features.boundary: Saved staff views/column profiles are future scope. Export labels must reflect the actual query/selection; PDF-specific allowlists are not a blanket medical redaction guarantee.

features.capability: Existing preview/apply/provenance patterns, domain import runbooks, synthetic CSV examples, catalog JSON/CSV and made-up PDF outputs are already in Git.
features.boundary: This pack indexes those assets. It does not rebuild import preparation or authorize real production apply.

features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: Encrypted birth dates and narrow Health Record, registrar entry-only, acknowledgment, administrator break-glass and sealed-copy foundations are present.
features.boundary: ADR 0005 has addendum-specific statuses and production prerequisites. Addendum B is interim accepted; the overall broader policy and Addendum C are separate. No blanket availability/compliance claim.

features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: An enabled event can offer the existing opt-in community with conduct acceptance, posts/replies, reporting and moderation foundations.
features.boundary: Profiles, directories, groups/media, richer moderation and lifecycle are separate later/policy-bound slices; do not advertise a general social network.

features.status: implemented but gated or needs setup
features.capability: Event archive/unarchive, audit trails, readiness/health surfaces, queued work and backup/restore tooling exist.
features.boundary: Archive hides an event without deleting records and is not the same as full financial closeout. A readiness tick is evidence, not a deployment or enabling action.

features.capability: Accepted direction gives attendee, director, coordinator and administrator one visual language with different navigation, scope and priorities.
features.boundary: The visual prototypes are reference documents; implementation remains in existing child issues. Later page studies do not add extra System menu changes.

features.feature: Builder extraction and editable Form templates
features.capability: Steps 1/2a/2b cover behavior-preserving extraction, immutable app-editable templates and source/version notices.
features.boundary: The October 20 decision permits foundation work before later visual review; this does not move the #98 queue or codex-ready frontier.

features.feature: Inspector, saved questions, phone editor and All/Any
features.capability: Proposed next builder steps clarify field/settings ownership, copied saved questions, phone move/edit workflows and combined visibility conditions.
features.boundary: Steps 3–6 retain separate design review. All/Any direction is accepted; that does not approve every proposed visual/library/permission detail.

features.feature: Themes, composed previews and full site builder
features.capability: Registration themes/state previews can lead to versioned pages, dynamic modules, branding, publish/rollback and optional domains.
features.boundary: #283/#284 are earlier bounded foundations; #247–#251/#270 own the broader site outcome and publication evidence. Do not wait for all future pages to improve today’s event page.

features.feature: Saved task views and reviewed bulk operations
features.capability: Personal/shared views, stable column choices, dashboard drilldowns and a consistent scoped export/action framework extend existing search.
features.boundary: Existing attendee CSV and director saved export formats are delivered and should be reused; a saved view cannot grant field access.

features.feature: Adventurer ministry and voluntary YMMS migration
features.capability: The recorded direction is separate clubs per ministry, director-set classes, shared honors/awards catalog and whole-ministry coordinator visibility initially.
features.boundary: This is a later project awaiting materials and survey answers. Migration is voluntary club by club; parent registration/unit scoring/training are independent later needs.

features.feature: Shared ledger, held credits and installment convenience
features.capability: Append-only shared charges/allocations, settlement reconciliation, transfers/held credits and optional installment charging extend current financial workflows.
features.boundary: Do not mistake the current meal ledger or immutable invoices for the completed shared financial ledger; recurring processor authorization/terms remain gated.

features.feature: Public merchandise and camp-store account possibilities
features.capability: Existing catalog foundations can support future reserved inventory, separately paid merchandise and later store/cashless-account concepts.
features.boundary: Merchandise checkout/fulfillment slices remain held; draft #302 was closed without merging. Camp-store wallets/POS are a separate bigger scope.

features.capability: Future camp operations could combine enrollment, cabins/counselors, activity schedules, transport, authorized release, personnel and incident controls.
features.boundary: Today’s lodging/meals/check-in are reusable foundations, not proof of a complete camp product. The separate UltraCamp discovery report identifies contracts and gaps.

features.feature: Returning profiles, wallet passes and native app
features.capability: Reviewed reusable facts/prefill, Apple/Google Wallet, a mobile attendee shell, minimized offline support and opt-in push are tracked possibilities.
features.boundary: Current account profile/prefill, web QR and phone-responsive web screens already exist. Native/provider deployment, offline actions and cross-event identity need their own contracts.

features.feature: Partner API, eAdventist and optional UltraCamp
features.capability: A scoped first-party/public contract, signed outbound webhooks and reviewed external directory feeds could extend owned data flows.
features.boundary: The eAdventist CSV organization import already exists; it is not an approved live person-membership API. UltraCamp remains optional lowest-priority Phase 5 and requires an allowed data/licensing boundary.

features.feature: Outcomes, personnel, incidents and advanced event tools
features.capability: Survey/certificate/outcome tools, recruiting/onboarding, restricted incidents, budgets/procurement, presenter portals, networking and hybrid delivery remain long-term domains.
features.boundary: Some have detailed technical slices, others remain planning epics. A roadmap entry is not a committed date, approved policy or current product promise.
